journey.name: MOD-08: 平台审计日志与能力采集
journey.description: 验证用户在平台管理中进入审计日志模块，查看本地不可篡改操作流水（登录、会话创建、插件执行、断开连接等事实），核查系统事件记录真实完整且不含假数据。

actions.action: Click the "设置" action icon in top bar
Verify that the "设置与平台管理" screen is displayed
Swipe down to the audit log section
Verify that the "审计记录" card or header is displayed
Verify that the audit event list container is present
Click the "返回" icon to return to workbench
Verify that the workbench is displayed
